description: This file defines test collection configurations and fixtures for Orleans-based tests, including collections for default clusters and environment setup, as well as a base fixture for Azure integration tests.

classes.name: DefaultClusterTestCollection
classes.description: Defines a test collection for tests requiring a default Orleans cluster setup, sharing a single cluster instance.

classes.name: TestEnvironmentFixtureCollection
classes.description: Defines a test collection for tests that require shared test environment configuration and setup.

classes.name: BaseAzureTestClusterFixture
classes.description: Abstract base fixture class for Azure integration tests, ensuring Azure Storage connectivity before test execution.

methods.name: CheckPreconditionsOrThrow
methods.description: Overrides the method to include Azure Storage connectivity check before proceeding with tests.
